canonicalFacts.claim: MASLD affects approximately 30-40% of the general adult population globally and is the most common chronic liver disease worldwide
MASLD encompasses a spectrum from isolated steatosis to MASH, fibrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma
MASLD is associated with increased morbidity and mortality from liver-related complications, cardiovascular disease, and certain cancers
MASLD is defined as steatotic liver disease in the presence of one or more cardiometabolic risk factors and absence of harmful alcohol intake
Liver biopsy remains the gold standard for diagnosing and staging MASH and fibrosis

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Weight loss and lifestyle modifications are first-line interventions for MASLD management
Case-finding strategies should focus on identifying MASLD with liver fibrosis in high-risk populations

redFlags: MASLD increases risk of hepatocellular carcinoma and liver-related mortality
10% of children with MASLD present with advanced fibrosis
MASLD is projected to become the leading indication for liver transplantation
